t: You are on Petty France, a street in the City of Westminster. It links Buckingham Gate with Broadway and Queen Anne's Gate. The street used to be called York Street. The name Petty France has also been used for the area around it, which was part of the seventh ward of Westminster. The physician Gideon Harvey, who lived from 1671 to 1755, died here. He held several offices within the Royal College of Physicians.
